# bkt group

Manage Bitbucket Cloud workspace groups through the legacy 1.0 group APIs.

These commands are Cloud-only and use the active context workspace unless
--workspace is supplied. Review group membership and resource permissions before
deleting a group because deletion can remove access across multiple projects and
repositories.

```
bkt group <command> [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
bkt group list --workspace my-team
  bkt group create developers --workspace my-team
  bkt group member add developers --user user@example.com --workspace my-team
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description | Key Flags |
|---|---|---|
| [create](#bkt-group-create) | Create a workspace group | `--workspace` |
| [delete](#bkt-group-delete) | Delete a workspace group | `--workspace`, `--yes` |
| [list](#bkt-group-list) | List workspace groups | `--workspace` |
| [member](#bkt-group-member) | Manage workspace group members | — |

## bkt group delete

Delete a Bitbucket Cloud workspace group.

The command prompts for confirmation by default because deleting a group can
remove access across multiple projects and repositories. Use --yes to skip the
prompt for non-interactive operation.

**Alias:** `rm`

### Usage

```
bkt group delete <group-slug> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--workspace` |  | Bitbucket workspace override (Cloud) |
| `--yes` | `-y` | Skip the confirmation prompt |
